name: Autoclave readiness check
description: Practice the simulated equipment check, cycle start, and readiness review.

steps.title: Review autoclave safety
steps.instructions: Acknowledge the autoclave safety prompt. Follow your approved site procedures before working with equipment.

steps.title: Check in autoclave equipment
steps.instructions: In this simulation, check the autoclave equipment in to the training system.

steps.title: Load the test pack and close the doors
steps.instructions: In this simulation, place the test pack inside and confirm the autoclave doors are shut. Follow your approved site procedures for real equipment.

steps.title: Press Start
steps.instructions: Simulate pressing Start to begin the training cycle.

steps.title: Was there an alarm?
steps.instructions: Record whether an alarm occurred during the simulated cycle. Follow the configured training route and your site's approved procedures.

steps.title: Did the autoclave pass the air removal test?
steps.instructions: Record the simulated air removal test result. Follow the configured training route and your site's approved procedures.

steps.title: Assign autoclave status
steps.instructions: In this simulation, assign the autoclave status as Available.
